pages.text: Fear is a harmful effect that randomly pushes a player sideways each tick. Nazar can spend 20 power to remove it during its two-second check. Milk also clears the effect through normal potion rules.

A successful melee hit from a $(l:sympathy/druden)Druden$() inflicts Fear for 25 seconds. The effect changes player motion; it does not make mobs flee. Wear $(l:beginnings/protective_charms)Nazar$() with a charged Grimoire for its periodic cleansing, or use milk.
